name: Ma Cheng

behavior.core_traits: quick, protective, aggressive about initiative but not wasteful with riders
behavior.speech_pattern: fast questions about distance, timing, escape routes, and what the enemy can reach before help arrives
behavior.values: mobility, commander survival, fresh horses, decisive local superiority
behavior.conflict_style: presses for action when delay increases danger; yields when the ground or horses make speed a lie
behavior.individual_tell: rests a thumb against the spear ferrule while listening
behavior.professional_bias: sees the battlefield in minutes and routes rather than lines on a static map

narration_rule: Static behavior guidance only; mutable goals, relationships, knowledge, health, authority, and outcomes remain in live state.
